# Holi User

Holi User is the local-first identity, vault, anonymous chat, and P2P
collaboration surface for Holi.tools.

## URL

- https://user.holi.tools/

## Mission

Let users own identity and workspace data locally, then share or collaborate
explicitly through cryptographic/P2P protocols instead of central accounts.

## Implementation Parameters

- App package: `holi-user`
- App path: `web/apps/user`
- Identity/store code: `web/apps/user/src/lib`
- P2P and chat code: `web/apps/user/src/lib/p2p`
- Friend handshake code: `web/apps/user/src/lib/friends`
- Current architecture: `web/apps/user/about.md`
- Privacy model: `docs/privacy.md`
- Current priorities: `docs/roadmap.md`

## Privacy And Security Notes

- Treat this app as security-sensitive.
- Do not claim production-grade cryptographic guarantees unless supported by
  the current spec and implementation.
- Default posture: local-first, explicit sharing, no unnecessary server trust.
